purpose: Form PAS-8 is used by a public company as a notice for the bearers of share warrants to surrender their warrants and get the shares dematerialised.
who: Every public company which issued share warrants prior to commencement of the Companies Act, 2013 and not converted into shares.
when: Within a period of six months of the commencement of the Companies (Prospectus and Allotment of Securities) Second Amendment Rules, 2023.
steps: Require the bearers of the share warrants to surrender such warrants to the company.
Place a notice for the bearers of share warrants in Form PAS-8 on the website of the company, if any.
Publish the notice in a newspaper in the vernacular language in circulation in the district of the registered office.
Publish the notice in an English language newspaper widely circulated in the State of the registered office.
checklist: Check details of share warrants issued prior to the commencement of the Companies Act, 2013.
Prepare the notice in Form PAS-8.
Arrange for website publication of the notice.
watch: Bearers must surrender share warrants within six months of the commencement of the rules, otherwise the company will convert and transfer them to the Investor Education and Protection Fund.
